meta_description: Trees & Gardens Liverpool offers expert arboricultural services including tree surgery, removal, and garden maintenance across Merseyside. Call for a free survey today.
hero_eyebrow: Certified Arborist — Safe Tree Removal & Care
hero_subhead: From overgrown branches threatening your roof to complete tree removal, we handle it safely and leave your garden tidy.
services_subhead: Whether you need a single branch trimmed or a mature oak felled, we handle every job with expertise and care.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe, fully insured removal of any size tree. We dismantle large trees in confined spaces and haul away all debris, leaving your garden clear.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Thinning
services.desc: Reduce tree height or density to restore views, improve light, and reduce wind resistance. Promotes healthier growth and extends the life of the tree.

services.title: Deadwood & Branch Removal
services.desc: Remove dead wood, low-hanging branches, and limbs touching property or cables. Prevents damage and improves safety around your home.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Pruning
services.desc: Expert pruning to shape and maintain fruit trees, ornamentals, and mature specimens. Encourages healthy growth and keeps your garden looking sharp.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Remove troublesome stumps completely using specialist grinding equipment. Reclaim usable garden space and prevent regrowth and pest issues.

services.title: Hedge Cutting & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular hedge trimming and reshaping to keep boundaries smart and healthy. We clear all clippings and leave your garden immaculate.

about_pullquote: A healthy tree is an asset; a neglected one becomes a liability. We get the balance right.
about_para_1: Trees & Gardens Liverpool was founded on the principle that proper tree care should be affordable, honest, and done right first time. Over 18 years, we've built a reputation for safely removing and maintaining hundreds of trees across Merseyside, from Victorian oaks to modern ornamentals. Our team is trained in modern climbing techniques, stump grinding, and arboricultural best practice—and we're fully insured for every job.
about_para_2: Local homeowners and businesses return to us because we turn up on time, explain what we're doing, and leave no mess behind. We don't oversell work, and we never leave a job half-finished. Your tree's health—and your garden's safety—is our priority, not a sales target.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive ash tree right above the garage. Thought it would be a fortune to remove. Got Trees & Gardens out, they quoted fair, and got it down and stump ground in one morning. No fuss, no mess. Brilliant job.
reviews.author: Martin T.

reviews.text: Our neighbour recommended them after they cleared a dead oak from their garden. We had three overgrown conifers. The lads were professional, worked efficiently, and the garden looked twice the size when they'd finished. Proper tidy workers.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Emergency call after a storm brought a branch down onto the conservatory roof. They came the same day, made it safe, and didn't charge a fortune. Saved us from a much bigger headache. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David M.
